verses.text: A good name is worth more than great riches. Being respected is better than silver and gold.
Rich people and poor people have this in common: the LORD made them all.
Sensible people see danger coming and hide, but simple people keep going and suffer for it.
Humility and respect for the LORD bring wealth, honour, and life.
Thorns and traps lie on the path of crooked people. Whoever protects their life stays far away from them.
Teach children the way they should go, and when they are old they will not turn away from it.
Rich people rule over poor people. The borrower is a slave to the lender.
Whoever plants evil will harvest trouble, and the rod they used in anger will be broken.
A generous person will be blessed, because they share their food with the poor.
Drive out the mocker, and fighting will stop. Arguments and insults will end.
Whoever loves a pure heart and speaks kindly will have the king as a friend.
The LORD's eyes watch over knowledge, but he ruins the words of the unfaithful.
A lazy person says, "There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!"
The mouth of an unfaithful woman is a deep pit. Whoever the LORD is angry with will fall into it.
Foolishness is tied up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline will drive it far away.
Whoever crushes the poor to get rich, or gives gifts to the rich, will end up poor.
Listen carefully to the sayings of the wise. Set your heart on what I teach.
It is good to keep these sayings in your heart and have them ready on your lips.
I am teaching you today, yes, you, so that you will put your trust in the LORD.
I have written thirty sayings for you, full of good advice and knowledge,
to teach you what is true and right, so you can give honest answers to those who sent you.
Do not take advantage of poor people just because they are poor. Do not crush the needy in court.
The LORD will take up their case and take the life of those who rob them.
Do not make friends with a hot-tempered person. Do not spend time with someone who is easily angered,
or you may learn their ways and trap yourself.
Do not be one who shakes hands to guarantee someone else's debts.
If you cannot pay, they will take even the bed you are sleeping on.
Do not move the ancient boundary stone that your ancestors set up.
Do you see someone who is skilled at their work? They will serve kings, not unimportant people.
